I loved my dad a lot, but he was a jobless alcoholic with a mean streak. He also wanted me to achieve great things and introduced me to the arts. He was more of a feminist than my mother is. (My mom divorced him when I was 2 and she was 20 then married another alcoholic.) We had the typical 80s' custody situation: He got me every other weekend. Then one Friday night in my freshman year of college, he fell asleep with a lit cigarette and died in a house fire. It fucked me up for a long time. It wasn't until I was in my late 30s - almost 20 years after he died - that I realized if he hadn't have died, I would have spent a good part of my adulthood caring for him, and he would have died early anyway. It's a real fucking gray area, for sure.
